architectural-designer.intro: We're looking for an architectural designer to join our studio in Namangan, working across residential and commercial projects from early concept through construction documentation.
requirements: A strong design sensibility, shown through a portfolio with complete design processes, not just final renders
Comfort working in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, or similar tools, alongside a rendering package such as Enscape, Lumion, or D5
Ability to take a project from concept sketch through construction-ready documentation
A collaborative mindset — our projects move fast and depend on close teamwork with interior and visualization colleagues
architectural-designer.howToApply: Message us on Telegram with a short introduction and a link to your portfolio.

interior-designer.intro: We're looking for an interior designer to join our studio in Namangan, shaping material, lighting, and furniture decisions across residential and commercial interiors.
requirements: A portfolio showing a clear point of view on material, light, and detail
Comfort working in AutoCAD or SketchUp for layout and detailing, plus a rendering package for presentation
Experience specifying furniture, fixtures, and finishes for real, buildable projects
Close attention to how spaces are actually lived in and used, not just how they photograph
interior-designer.howToApply: Message us on Telegram with a short introduction and a link to your portfolio.

facade-designer.intro: We're looking for an exterior and facade designer to join our studio in Namangan, developing the massing, materiality, and building envelope for our architectural projects.
requirements: A portfolio showing facade and massing studies, not only interior or rendering work
Comfort working in Rhino, Grasshopper, Revit, or similar tools for envelope and detailing studies
An understanding of how material choice, climate, and construction method shape a facade
Ability to coordinate facade decisions with the wider architectural and interior teams
facade-designer.howToApply: Message us on Telegram with a short introduction and a link to your portfolio.

visualization-artist.intro: We're looking for a 3D visualization artist to join our studio in Namangan, producing the renders and walkthroughs that carry our projects from pitch to construction.
requirements: A portfolio of photoreal architectural or interior renders
Proficiency in 3ds Max, SketchUp, or Blender, alongside a renderer such as Corona, V-Ray, Enscape, or D5
An eye for lighting, material, and composition that reads as real, not just polished
Ability to work from architectural/interior drawings and turn them into accurate, believable scenes
visualization-artist.howToApply: Message us on Telegram with a short introduction and a link to your portfolio.

AboutNarrative.heading: About Castler
intro: Castler is an architecture and design company, focused on commercial work, practising in Namangan, Uzbekistan since 2013. Over more than twelve years, the company's projects have realised approximately 200,000 m² — from private homes to large-scale retail and business developments.

The company was founded by architect Otabek Isoqjonov, who continues to serve as its creative lead today — and is widely known on Instagram, where his work reaches hundreds of thousands of followers across Uzbekistan. Castler works across two core disciplines — interior design and architecture/exterior design — bringing together the right expertise for each project.

sections.title: Why Castler
body: For Castler, good architecture has to deliver two things at once: strong design and a working business outcome. We evaluate a project not only on how it looks, but on how it performs — how it generates revenue, how flexible it is, and how usable it remains over time. For commercial clients, that means every square metre is accounted for, and design decisions hold up as a sound investment, not just a good picture.

That is what sets Castler apart from studios built around a single style or material. Every Castler project is shaped by the specific building type, the client's goals, and market demand — not a house aesthetic applied regardless of context. The work still starts with the person: who will use this space, and how should they feel in it — but that understanding is then translated into a concrete, measurable result.

sections.title: Full ownership
body: Castler carries a project from initial concept through structural and engineering solutions to on-site construction supervision. Clients work with one team for the entire process, rather than coordinating multiple separate contractors themselves.

sections.title: Experience and scale
body: Castler's portfolio spans private houses, villas, multi-storey residential buildings, restaurants, office centres, and large commercial developments. Among its most significant projects is Afsona Mall, a 50,000 m² shopping centre selected in competition with an international contractor and currently in the construction-supervision phase — a live proof point of Castler's ability to manage large, complex commercial work.

sections.title: Values
body: Castler declines certain projects on principle — including work for alcohol-related businesses. The company's guiding philosophy is to look upon the world with the aim of making places prosper and people rejoice, reflected in its tagline: "Through the lens of life, better places." In practice, that means a commitment to spaces that are not only beautiful, but genuinely functional and profitable to their owners.

sections.title: From Namangan to Uzbekistan
body: Founded in Namangan, Castler now works with serious clients and commercial projects across Uzbekistan. The company is actively growing and planning to open a Tashkent office, as it builds a national reputation as a trusted partner in commercial architecture.
